brief: Lowers a Heavy or Light Bowgun's reload rating by 1 step, moving ammo toward slower reloads. On the Bow, loading a coating takes 110% of the usual time.
Lowers a Heavy or Light Bowgun's reload rating by 2 steps, moving ammo toward slower reloads. On the Bow, loading a coating takes 120% of the usual time.
Lowers a Heavy or Light Bowgun's reload rating by 3 steps, moving ammo toward slower reloads. On the Bow, loading a coating takes 130% of the usual time.
Lowers a Heavy or Light Bowgun's recoil rating by 3 steps, moving every ammo three steps toward the lightest recoil.
Lowers a Heavy or Light Bowgun's recoil rating by 2 steps, moving every ammo two steps toward the lightest recoil. Stonefist Soul and Stonefist Soul X count as this skill.
Lowers a Heavy or Light Bowgun's recoil rating by 1 step, moving every ammo one step toward the lightest recoil.
Raises a Heavy or Light Bowgun's recoil rating by 1 step, moving ammo one step toward the heaviest recoil; ammo not at the edge of a recoil band is unchanged.
Raises a Heavy or Light Bowgun's recoil rating by 2 steps, moving every ammo two steps toward the heaviest recoil.
Raises a Heavy or Light Bowgun's recoil rating by 3 steps, moving every ammo three steps toward the heaviest recoil.
Removes Bowgun deviation completely, so every gun fires straight. Paired with Felyne Temper it only lowers deviation by one level.
Lowers Bowgun deviation by one level: severe becomes mild and mild becomes none, still to the gun's own side. Felyne Temper cancels it out.
Makes Bowgun deviation one level worse: a gun with none gets mild deviation to either side at random, and mild becomes severe.
Makes Bowgun deviation two levels worse, so every gun ends at severe; a gun with no deviation gets severe deviation to either side at random.
Normal S Lv1 to Lv3, Light Bowgun charged shots and Rapid arrows deal x1.1 damage. On Bowgun shots it stacks with Felyne Sharpshooter for x1.21.
Every hit of Pierce S Lv1 to Lv3 and Pierce arrows deals x1.1 damage. Silver Bullet counts as this skill, so the two do not stack.
Pellet S (and the fragments Shrapnel S breaks into) deal x1.2 damage, and Spread arrows x1.3. Silver Bullet counts as this skill, so the two do not stack.
Heavy S Lv1 and Lv2 and Heavy arrows deal x1.1 damage. Silver Bullet does not cover Heavy shots, so this is the only way to boost them.
Lets a Heavy or Light Bowgun load Normal S Lv1, Lv2 and Lv3 even if it normally can't, using the gun's own clip size for that ammo.
Lets a Heavy or Light Bowgun load Pierce S Lv1, Lv2 and Lv3 even if it normally can't, using the gun's own clip size for that ammo.
Lets a Heavy or Light Bowgun load Pierce S Lv1 even if it normally can't, using the gun's own clip size; Lv2 and Lv3 are not affected.
Lets a Heavy or Light Bowgun load Pellet S Lv1, Lv2 and Lv3 even if it normally can't, using the gun's own clip size for that ammo.
Lets a Heavy or Light Bowgun load Pellet S Lv1 even if it normally can't, using the gun's own clip size; Lv2 and Lv3 are not affected.
Lets a Heavy or Light Bowgun load Crag S Lv1, Lv2 and Lv3 even if it normally can't, using the gun's own clip size for that ammo.
Lets a Heavy or Light Bowgun load Crag S Lv1 even if it normally can't, using the gun's own clip size; Lv2 and Lv3 are not affected.
Lets a Heavy or Light Bowgun load Clust S Lv1, Lv2 and Lv3 even if it normally can't, using the gun's own clip size for that ammo.
Lets a Heavy or Light Bowgun load Clust S Lv1 even if it normally can't, using the gun's own clip size; Lv2 and Lv3 are not affected.
Lets a Bow load the plain Poison Coating even if it normally can't; a Bow that already has it keeps its own version, boosted (+) included. No effect on Bowguns.
Lets a Bow load the plain Para Coating even if it normally can't; a Bow that already has it keeps its own version, boosted (+) included. No effect on Bowguns.
Lets a Bow load the plain Sleep Coating even if it normally can't; a Bow that already has it keeps its own version, boosted (+) included. No effect on Bowguns.
Lets a Bow load the plain Power Coating Lv1 and Lv2 even if it normally can't; a Bow that already has them keeps its own versions, boosted (+) included.
Lets a Bow load the plain Power Coating Lv1 even if it normally can't; Lv2 is not affected. A Bow that already has it keeps its own version.
Lets a Bow load the plain Elem Coating Lv1 and Lv2, but only if the Bow has an element; on a Bow without one it unlocks nothing.
Lets a Bow load the plain Elem Coating Lv1, but only if the Bow has an element; on a Bow without one it unlocks nothing. Lv2 is not affected.
Lets a Bow load the plain C.Range Coating even if it normally can't; a Bow that already has it keeps its own version, boosted (+) included. No effect on Bowguns.
Lets a Bow load the plain Exhaust Coating even if it normally can't; a Bow that already has it keeps its own version, boosted (+) included. No effect on Bowguns.
Lets a Bow load the plain Blast Coating even if it normally can't; a Bow that already has it keeps its own version, boosted (+) included. No effect on Bowguns.
Adds one shot to every Light Bowgun rapid fire, and the Alchemy Bullet bursts 3 instead of 2. Does nothing for the Heavy Bowgun or the Bow.
Stretches a shot's second damage stage: 0.13 s longer for Normal S, 0.2 s for Pierce S, while Heavy S reaches later stages sooner. Pellet, Crag, Clust and elemental shots are unchanged.
Adds 1 round to every Bowgun ammo clip, 1 Bow charge level (up to 4) and 1 Gunlance shell, and Charge Blade charges fill more phials (still under the phial cap).
Bowgun internal ammo and the Bow's Arc Shot deal x1.2 damage, and the Bow's Power Shot x1.4. On the Bow it multiplies with the ammo Up skills.
Each use of Bowgun ammo or a Bow coating has a 20% chance not to be used up. Despite the description, it does nothing for phials or shells.
Adds +30% affinity on every weapon, counted right after the weapon's own affinity. Total affinity is capped at 100%.
Adds +20% affinity on every weapon, counted right after the weapon's own affinity. Total affinity is capped at 100%.
Adds +10% affinity on every weapon, counted right after the weapon's own affinity. Total affinity is capped at 100%.
Takes 5% off affinity; negative affinity turns some hits into weak hits (x0.75 damage). On weapons with a hidden negative share, the 5 is added to that share instead.
Takes 10% off affinity; negative affinity turns some hits into weak hits (x0.75 damage). On weapons with a hidden negative share, the 10 is added to that share instead.
Takes 15% off affinity; negative affinity turns some hits into weak hits (x0.75 damage). On weapons with a hidden negative share, the 15 is added to that share instead.
Gives +50% affinity to any hit on a body part with a hitzone value of 45 or more. It is checked hit by hit, so it never shows on the status screen.
Landing hits gives +25% affinity (1 to 4 hits) or +30% (5 hits). Each hit restarts a 5 second timer; when it runs out the count drops to 0.
Critical hits build up poison, paralysis or sleep x1.2, the same on every weapon. Bitter Affinity's strong hits count as crits too.
Critical hits deal more element damage by weapon: x1.35 for Sword & Shield, Bow and Dual Blades, x1.3 for Bowguns, x1.2 for Great Sword, x1.25 for the rest.
Critical hits deal x1.4 damage instead of x1.25. Weak hits stay at x0.75, and Bitter Affinity's x2.0 strong hits are unchanged.
About 1 in 4 weak hits (x0.75) become strong hits worth x2.0. Only works with negative affinity or a weapon's hidden negative share; strong hits count as crits for Elemental Crit and Status Crit.
Long Sword, Charge Blade, Dual Blades and Switch Axe gauges fill about 20% faster, and Great Sword, Hammer, Bow and some Light Bowgun charges reach each level about 20% sooner.
Long Sword, Charge Blade, Dual Blades and Switch Axe gauges fill about 20% slower, and Great Sword, Hammer, Bow and some Light Bowgun charges take about 20% longer. Focus cancels it.
Halves the Stamina drained by sprinting and other continuous drains (x0.5), so a sprint lasts about twice as long. Felyne Escape Artist (sprint) or Felyne Supercat (the other drains) halve it again.
Sprinting and other continuous drains use 20% more Stamina (x1.2), so a full sprint lasts about 83% as long. Marathon Runner cancels it.
Halves the Stamina cost of evades and other one-off Stamina costs (x0.5): a roll that costs 25 Stamina costs 12.5.
Cuts the Stamina cost of evades and other one-off costs to x0.75 (a 25 Stamina roll costs 18.75). With Bubbly Dance's bubble or Felyne Black Belt it reaches x0.5.
Evades and other one-off Stamina costs cost 20% more (x1.2): a 25 Stamina roll costs 30. Bubbly Dance's bubble or Felyne Black Belt brings it back to normal.
Evades and other one-off Stamina costs cost 35% more (x1.35): a 25 Stamina roll costs 33.75.
Doubles how fast Stamina refills (x2), at every refill rate, so an empty Stamina bar refills in half the time.
Stamina refills at x0.75 speed, so an empty bar takes about 1.33 times as long. Stam Recov Up or a skill that grants it cancels it.
Sprinting stops draining Stamina once you are at 25 or lower, so the sprint goes on and you keep 25 Stamina for an evade. Other continuous drains get the same floor.
Doubles the basic roll's invulnerability from 0.2 s to 0.4 s, and lengthens other evades' windows too.
Lengthens the basic roll's invulnerability from 0.2 s to 0.33 s, and other evades' windows too. While Bubbly Dance's bubble is on, it works like Evasion +2.
Halves the basic roll's invulnerability from 0.2 s to 0.1 s, and shortens other evades' windows too. Bubbly Dance's bubble brings them back to normal.
Evades on all fourteen weapons travel further: most get an extra push through their middle and end, while the start is unchanged (Hunting Horn evade movement x1.3).
After a few evades (4 rolls) you are bubbled for 90 seconds, gaining one extra level of Evasion and of Constitution. It also applies under a monster's bubbles.
Lowers the guard power of every attack you block by 20, for a lighter guard reaction, a smaller stamina cost and, on the Great Sword and Charge Blade, less sharpness lost.
Lowers the guard power of every attack you block by 10, for a lighter guard reaction, a smaller stamina cost and, on the Great Sword and Charge Blade, less sharpness lost.
Raises the guard power of every attack you block by 10, for a heavier guard reaction, a bigger stamina cost and, on the Great Sword and Charge Blade, more sharpness lost.
Lets you block attacks marked as needing Guard Up, and blocked hits no longer give Defense Down. It does not widen your guard and never works on the Long Sword.
Multiplies the stun (KO) value of your hits by 1.1, rounded down, so a hit needs a stun value of 10 or more to gain anything.
Multiplies the exhaust value of your hits by 1.2, rounded down. Hits that have no exhaust value gain nothing.
Hunting Horn melody effects last longer (x1.17 to x2, depending on the effect), and item horns and flutes get a 50% chance not to break.
Gunlance shells and Wyvern's Fire x1.2, Charge Blade phial bursts x1.35, Crag S, Cannon S and Wyvern S x1.3, Ballista shots x1.2; Wyvern's Fire Overheat drops from 120 to 90 s.
Gunlance shells and Wyvern's Fire x1.1, Charge Blade phial bursts x1.3, Crag S, Cannon S and Wyvern S x1.15, Ballista shots x1.1; Wyvern's Fire costs a third less heat.
Damage to a monster's breakable parts is x1.3 while the part still has a break left, so a part needing 300 damage breaks at about 231.
Bomb damage x1.3 and Blast buildup x1.2, and Combinations for bombs, Gunpowder and Blast Coating always succeed.
Triggers after losing over 180 Health or after a 5 minute count: +50% affinity and x0.25 Stamina use for 150 s. Gives nothing while Challenger or Peak Performance is on.
Triggers after losing over 180 Health or after a 5 minute count: +30% affinity and half Stamina use for 150 s. Gives nothing while Challenger or Peak Performance is on.
+20 attack and +15% affinity once a large monster in your area has been enraged for 3 seconds. Peak Performance and Latent Power do not apply while it is on.
+10 attack and +10% affinity once a large monster in your area has been enraged for 3 seconds. Peak Performance and Latent Power do not apply while it is on.
+20 attack while your Health is full, added before multipliers such as Fortify. Any damage turns it off, and it gives nothing while Challenger's bonus is on.
For 60 s after a large monster in your area does certain actions, Hunter Art hits deal x1.2 and Arts started in that window get their own boost, such as a longer effect.
At or below two thirds Health: attack x1.1 and every elemental resistance becomes 50, but you are always Dragonblighted. Dragon element weapons keep their element; others lose it.
At or below 40% Health, attack is multiplied by x1.3 and the low-Health defense bonus rises from +30 to +45.
At or below 40% Health, the low-Health defense bonus rises from +30 to +45; attack is unchanged. It also stops Worrywart's penalties.
At or below 40% Health, attack drops to x0.7 and the low-Health defense bonus falls from +30 to +21. Adrenaline +1 or +2 overrides it.
After 1/2 faints, attack x1.1/x1.2 and defense x1.15/x1.3. The attack multiplier also boosts flat bonuses such as Attack Up.
+20 attack while you have red Health, until the red part recovers or you heal it. It is a flat bonus, so Fortify multiplies it.
+20 attack while you have an abnormal status, such as Poison, Sleep, paralysis, Stench, Bleeding, Defense Down or a blight. Several statuses at once still give +20.
If you had at least 64 Health, a hit that would make you faint leaves you at 1 Health instead. Works once per life and returns each time you faint.
Your weight when a monster picks its target is x0.8, so you are less likely to be chosen. The attention your actions build up is not reduced.
Your weight when a monster picks its target and the attention your actions build up are both x1.5. Does not stack with Felyne Provoker.
Your Palicoes' attack (melee and ranged) and defense are multiplied by x1.1.
Finishing the Fist Pump gesture calls back your fainted or recovering Palicoes; each one called back can't be called back again for 10 minutes.
